faq_heading: Abbotsford golf course homes: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a Abbotsford golf course home cost?
faq.a: Across 131 Abbotsford sales from November 2025 through October 2026, the golf course median came to $1,060,000, with the middle half between $950,000 and $1,247,500. All Abbotsford detached houses had a median of $1,050,000.

faq.q: What counts as a golf course home in Abbotsford?
faq.a: A detached house whose listing carries the Golf Course Nearby or Golf Course Dev. flag in Paragon. The listing agent enters it, so it covers homes near a course as well as on one.

faq.q: How fast do Abbotsford golf course homes sell?
faq.a: The median was 24 days on the market, closing at 97.1% of list, with 5% over the list price. All Abbotsford houses took 23 days.

faq.q: Which Abbotsford neighbourhoods have the most golf course homes?
faq.a: Abbotsford East had 111 sales with the flag, Central Abbotsford 10 and Abbotsford West 5 between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026.

This search lists detached houses for sale in Abbotsford that the listing marks as on or near a golf course. The most golf course sales were in Abbotsford East (111), Central Abbotsford (10) and Abbotsford West (5).

Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, Abbotsford recorded 591 detached house sales, and 131 of them (22%) had the flag. The median was $1,060,000, which is 1% above the $1,050,000 median across all Abbotsford houses.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a Abbotsford golf course home

items.t: Work out how close the lot is to the course, and which side of the house faces it. In Abbotsford, 131 sales carried the flag, and a house on a fairway is not the same as one a few blocks away. Abbotsford East had the most flagged sales (111).

Inspect the fence, windows and deck on the course side, and ask the seller about stray balls, netting or damage and whether insurance was involved. The typical house was built in 1996, which tells you how old the roof and windows facing the course may be.

Request the title. A right-of-way, covenant or setback can tie a lot to the course, and it shows on title, not on the listing. The flag appeared on 22% of Abbotsford house sales, so ask your agent which registered documents apply on Abbotsford East streets.
Tour at more than one time of day. Mowing starts early and summer evenings are busy. Golf course houses took 24 days to sell in Abbotsford, so there is time to go twice.
Weigh the price with similar houses without the flag. The golf course median was $1,060,000 and the all-house median $1,050,000, so check whether size and age explain the gap.
